items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of boat-dock permit
items.quote: Diese Entscheidung können Sie mit dem Widerspruch angreifen, den Sie binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift an den Landkreis Beispiel-Seenplatte, Der Landrat, Seenplattenring 12, 17033 Neu Beispielhagen, richten.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 09.12.2025; no separate 'zur Post gegeben' date given, so posting day = 09.12.2025. The letter is from a Landkreis (general authority, not a Finanzamt), so under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG M-V delivery is deemed on the 4th day after posting and this deemed-delivery day is NOT moved even if it falls on a weekend/holiday (unlike tax-office deliveries under § 108 Abs. 3 AO). 09.12.2025 + 4 calendar days = Sat 13.12.2025 → Bekanntgabe = 13.12.2025. The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 70 VwGO analogue, period computed per §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB): the day of Bekanntgabe (13.12.2025) is not counted; the period ends one month later on the day with the same number, i.e. 13.01.2026. 13.01.2026 is a Tuesday, not a Saturday/Sunday/public holiday in MV, so no shift under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG/§ 193 BGB is needed. Final deadline: 13.01.2026 (must reach the Landkreis by then).
